name: Catavrel
subcategory: selective paralytic — voluntary motor suppression with autonomic preservation
manufacturer: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals (disavowed research compound, synthesis leaked by internal whistleblower)
description: Catavrel was developed by Lazarus as a 'compliance assist' for involuntary psychiatric commitment procedures — a compound that eliminates voluntary motor function while preserving all autonomic processes and full consciousness. The subject cannot move, cannot speak, cannot signal distress, but their heart beats, their lungs breathe, their eyes track. They are a conscious, aware prisoner inside their own body. Lazarus buried the project after the whistleblower leak; the synthesis is now widely held by gray-market operators.
effects: selective voluntary motor system suppression within 60-90 seconds of vapor exposure
complete paralysis of all volitional movement including speech musculature
autonomic nervous system fully preserved — breathing, cardiac function, digestion unaffected
full sensory awareness and consciousness maintained
eyes remain mobile — the only visible sign of consciousness
side_effects: profound psychological trauma — locked-in experience causes acute panic and dissociation

subjects with BCI can still transmit neural signals — if their BCI includes emergency beacon or subvocalization interface, they may be able to signal for help (operators typically co-administer Vantacide)
re-dosing before clearance of first dose causes autonomic involvement — respiratory depression risk
post-dose: 50% of subjects experience temporary motor dysregulation (tremor, coordination loss) for 12-24 hours
repeated exposure causes permanent subtle motor degradation — fine motor control never fully recovers
duration: 90 minutes to 3 hours depending on dose; fully reversible without antidote
cultural_context: The Lazarus connection makes Catavrel uniquely politically charged in GLMZ. The whistleblower who leaked the synthesis — a Lazarus researcher named only 'Ariadne' in the leak documents — became a cause célèbre in Tier 2-3 activist circles. Lazarus has never acknowledged the compound. The irony that the largest pharmaceutical corp in GLMZ developed a locked-in paralytic for 'psychiatric compliance' is not lost on anyone, and it colors how people in lower tiers think about Lazarus products generally.
story_hooks: The whistleblower 'Ariadne' resurfaces — they have a second package of Lazarus documents, worse than the first. They need a crew to get it out. Lazarus security is already moving.

A Tier 3 family discovers their relative in a Lazarus psychiatric facility has been administered Catavrel repeatedly over six months — officially listed as 'experimental sedation protocol.' The relative is aware of everything that has been done to them.
A runner is hit with Catavrel in a crowded public space and left in a chair, fully conscious and unable to move. They have to watch their handler walk away and wait to see who comes to collect them.
